title: Thank you Juan
text: Great way to see the city and really inexpensive. We had Juan as our host / driver who was so knowledgeable about Seville, and provided helpful suggestions on where to spend our time. He was so freindly and personable, making the experience that much better. Gratsias Juan.
author: peterlP3669TP

title: Great tour
text: We had a fantastic private tuk tuk tour with Juan. He was warm, funny and very knowledgeable. He told us information that we hadn’t heard from other tour guides. He was an excellent driver and it didn’t feel scary following the traffic. We would thoroughly recommend this tour. We wished we had done it on day one

author: Tela_B

title: Enjoyable City Tour
text:
Juan was a great ambassador for Seville. The Tuk Tuk was very comfortable to ride in.  He provided a nice background on the city. Most of the sites to be seen were along the river and around the expo buildings. The tour does not take you to the cathedral or royal palace due to traffic restrictions.   Juan was as accommodating to our interests as he could be. The tour is especially good  for people who do not want to walk much.

author: Lori_B

title: Totally Worth It!
text: We took the 2-hr option and it did not disappoint. Excellent tour of the city, which includes stops for pictures. Impressed by Jorge. He was very sweet and had extensive knowledge about the history of Sevilla. He answered all of our questions with a smile, and even offered to take our pictures. 100% recommended.
author: Angelic_A

title: Perfect for Cruise Excursions
text: Great if you have limited time.  We were on a cruise excursion day so we had limited time but Javier was nice and accommodating and gave us a nice history of the city with seeing the major attractions.
